concerns.text: T040 is tagged [P] and 'Runs after T027', but it 'append[s] a "Power Analysis" section to the final report' — the report is produced by T033, which runs later (after T027B/T030/T031). Running T040 in parallel with T033 either fails (no report yet) or races on the same file. T040 must be ordered after T033 and must not be [P] relative to it.

T051 saves the best model to data/models/gap_predictor.pkl, 'overwriting only if validation correlation improves', and says 'Runs after T021A and before re-running T021B/T022A if the model changes.' But T021B, T022A, T027B, and T042 all consume gap_predictor.pkl and are scheduled earlier (Phases 4–6). A conditional 're-run if the model changes' makes every downstream artifact (test_metrics.json, final_consistency_summary.json, model_robustness.json, T033 report) potentially stale with no task enforcing regeneration. T051 should be deterministically ordered between T021A and T021B, or a re-validation task must be added after it.

concerns.location: tasks.md:Phase 4 task list order (T021A before T023)
concerns.text: T021A is listed before T023 in the Phase 4 list even though it declares 'Runs after T023'. The stated Execution Order section gets this right (T023 → T021A), but the list order invites a consumer-before-producer execution if the list is read top-to-bottom. Reorder T023 above T021A in the list.

T026A (producer of synchronized_inputs.json) is listed before T026, which is correct, but T026's own text says 'Runs after T026A' while T027 says 'Runs after T026, T026A' — redundant/consistent, no violation; however T026A lacks an explicit 'Runs after' anchor to the split/test artifacts its sibling T026 consumes (split_test.parquet from T021A). Add 'Runs after T021A' to T026A or T026 to close the gap.
